newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Two women killed in Hungary bombing - police.
newsitem.headline: Two women killed in Hungary bombing - police.

text.p: Two women were killed when a hand grenade exploded in the washroom of a Chinese restaurant in Budapest early on Friday, police said.

The two Chinese women were killed when they opened a plastic bag containing the hand grenade, police said. It was the latest and deadliest in a series of bomb attacks and shootings, some linked to gangland warfare, in the Hungarian capital.

Police said they had no immediate explanation of who had planted the booby-trapped sack containing the hand grenade at The Great Wall Restaurant and said they did not know if the two women were the intended victims.
"What we can say is that it was shortly after midnight, after the restaurant had closed, and there were no more guests in the restaurant," said police spokesman Andre Nagy.
"Since it was after closing time it means the attack was not aimed at the guests but against the owner or employees," he said. "It may have been a warning but against whom we don't know."

Since last September, Budapest has been shaken by a dozen bombings and at least a half dozen shootings in an apparent gangland war. One known gangland figure was killed last year when he was shot dead at the wheel of his car.
